findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 51 mm is observed in the tail of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with the superior mesenteric vein, suggesting potential invasion. No invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum is observed. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastases are observed in three nodes at station 8p and one node at station 18. No other evident metastases are observed.
